title: GASS Records — red, forest green, lilac, powder blue, peach
note: Pure red #FF0000 and near-black forest #00220B carry the page; lilac #D2BAD8, powder blue #AFCDDA and peach #FFBB90 are used as whole-band fills, never as tints. Text is always forest on light bands or blue/lilac on forest. Green-and-white checkerboard strips and an op-art striped sphere add pattern without any photos. Loud but tight: 5 flat colours, 1px black rules between bands.
